At line 18: `File tmp2 = file.getParentFile();`
This assigns a value to the variable `tmp2`.

This uses `tmp2` as an argument.

The variable `tmp2` is created from `file` (line 13), which is created from `name` (line 11). Specifically:
- Line 11: `name = mapper.map(getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName()))`
- Line 13: `File file = new File(outputDir, name)`
- Line 18: `File tmp2 = file.getParentFile()`

So `tmp2` is derived from `file`, which is derived from `name`. Therefore, the value of `tmp2` used at line 19 depends on the value of `name` at line 11.
